title: filenode: act on pending upstream filenode-19 findings
description: Tracking bead from audit JMAP-t8ej.5. brong/draft-gondwana-jmap-filenode issues, all OPEN; act once upstream decides. #6 shallow copy: crate already shallow; add doc comment + test once confirmed. #10 case-folding algorithm (PR #11): backend.rs:638-667 leaves it to backend, memory.rs uses to_lowercase; add i;unicode-casemap mode when decided. #12 Directory role: only chatspace is set-at-create (filenode.rs:1082-1097); no one-directory-per-role, no named right, L913 protection not enforced. #17 'changed' for per-user/inherited shareWith: memory backend never sets changed (memory.rs:398); blocked on per-user identity support. Not implemented, keep in mind for future beads: extract must reject '..', empty and leading-'/' names (#3/#4/#5), archive naming (#13/#14), PUT/PATCH If-Match (#7), SymLink resolution (#8/#9).
close_reason: Out of scope (Mark 2026-11-01): tracks Mark's own open upstream IETF proposals; WG decisions will arrive as new draft versions
